headline: Heavy Fighting Persists Across Six Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the war's most contested sectors have kept up a brutal tempo. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest theater, adding roughly 7,200 Colonial and 8,100 Warden casualties in the past day, though hourly loss rates have begun to cool. Nevish Line continues to bleed heavily with over 4,200 Colonial and 3,900 Warden losses, its casualty curves also easing. Marban Hollow and Kuura Strand each logged another 30‑plus base‑ownership changes in 24 hours, with Kuura Strand showing a sharp enlistment spike. Linn Mercy has accelerated on both sides, recording 83 Colonial and 182 Warden casualties per hour in the most recent window. Godcrofts saw a base turn neutral early this morning, the only fresh turnover there. Elsewhere the line has been largely static, with no captures reported in the last two hours across the majority of regions. Enlistment surges persist in the hottest zones, suggesting the current flare‑ups may sustain through the next day.
